name: French Winawer — Main Line
description: The sharp Winawer Variation of the French Defense. Black gives up the bishop pair early for dynamic counterplay and pressure against White's center.

lines.name: Winawer Variation — Main Line
lines.description: After 3.Nc3 Bb4, White plays e5 and a3. Black captures on c3, creating doubled pawns for White but gaining time and dark-square control. The position is unbalanced and full of tactics.
